```{r}
library(ISLR)
```

```{r}
data("Smarket")
```

```{r}
dim(Smarket)
```
```{r}
summary(Smarket)
```
```{r}
pairs(Smarket)
```
```{r}
cor(Smarket[,-9])
```
```{r}
attach(Smarket)
plot(Volume)
```
```{r}
glm.fit=glm(Direction~Lag1+Lag2+Lag3+Lag4+Lag5+Volume,data=Smarket,family=binomial) 
summary(glm.fit)
```
```{r}
coef(glm.fit)
```
```{r}
summary (glm.fit)$coef
```
```{r}
summary (glm.fit)$coef[,4]
```
```{r}
glm.pred=predict (glm.fit ,type="response")
glm.pred[1:10]
```
```{r}
contrasts(Direction)
```
```{r}
glm.preds=rep("Down" ,1250)
glm.preds[glm.pred >.5]=" Up"
```

```{r}
table(glm.preds,Direction)
```
```{r}
(507+145)/1250
```
```{r}
mean(glm.preds==Direction)
```
